constraints: Attach to the sole owner-managed local environment. Never launch another application or change NyxID configuration.
Two real EG processes and two Ready coordinated AMs sharing isolated storage; exact source and image bindings must accompany evidence.
Synthetic local platform and provider only. A local relay result is not a production bot or real third-party-platform acceptance result.
Acquire creates bounded fixture configuration only, never executes the feature under test. Public cleanup must be registered before mutation; reconcile unknown outcomes using the original key.
Adapters return observed raw fields and receipts, never PASS booleans or a runCase implementation. Missing methods throw BLOCKED.
Credentials stay in the adapter; request and observation records must omit secrets, sealed capabilities and raw identities. No Secret reads, pod exec, production writes or customer bots.

browser.adapter: Use developer-15 executable/browser.mjs createBrowserAdapter; do not launch a browser or another application.
browser.evidence: evidence(page) -> multi-am-browser-evidence-v1 with compiled_source, compiled_manifest, real_ui, secrets_redacted and correlated AM requests/owner proofs. Retained on failure and before close.
browser.setup: Parent supplies its leased Chromium, compiled web origin, two AM origins, permitted synthetic actors and the existing non-owner resolver. EG proxy paths must reach real EG, preserving its session. The web artifact must match the qualified parent binding.

eg.acquire: acquire({scenario,caseId,phase,iteration,am}) -> lease; seeds disposable fixture configuration, not the tested actions. Lease has close(), local:true, synthetic:true, replicas:[{slot:a|b,instance,image,ready}], expected, channelId.
eg.request: lease.request({method,path,body,key,actor,replica,allowed,...}) -> {status,body,instance,requestId,eg_receipt}. Real EG HTTP with safe credential injection inside adapter; expected status codes are forwarded. eg_receipt is a distinct EG receipt with actual c275-eg-serving-v1 snapshots before/after, request_id, method, status, started_at, ended_at and attribution; never AM ownership.
eg.configuration: Read actual saved producer configuration -> {platform,trustMode,issuer,keyId,routeId,callbackPath,verificationMode,durableCustomExecution,partition}; no credentials.
eg.platformSend: Send the specified synthetic platform wire event through the real verified ingress; return {platform,trustMode,eventId,conversationId,responseId,agentId,consumerId,egInstance,destination,expectedSender,expectedContentDigest,status|outcome}. Negative variants return explicit rejected/refused/ignored and no turn; expected fields derive from independently seeded inputs.
eg.waitForTurn: Observe bounded real provider/AM acceptance and return {eventId,conversationId,responseId,agentId,consumerId,servingAm,owningAm,epoch,providerAccepted,turnCount,effectCount,amRequests}. Both-AM attribution must be independently observed and each Agent-bound event routed through non-owner ingress. Required amRequests:[{am,request_id,status,elapsed_ms,serving,serving_after,started_at,ended_at,attribution,agent_id_sha256,owner_proof}] from actual parent NonOwnerRouter; proof includes request_id, ingress, owner, owner_epoch, kind, verdict and instance hashes. No reconstructed requested labels. egReceipts remain separately attributed to EG processes.
eg.waitForDelivery: Read synthetic platform's actual delivery capture -> {eventId,responseId,destination,sender,contentDigest,status,count,contextEventIds}. Do not infer delivery from 202 or provider acceptance.
eg.replayEvent: Resubmit identical retained signed bytes/key through requested EG replica, preserving event identity.
eg.recoverResponse: Read/reconnect the retained response via peer AM without new admission -> same turn fields plus recoveryMode:read_existing,resubmissions:0.
eg.counters: Independent provider/platform counts of actual turns/effects, scoped to this fixture.
eg.quiesce: Bounded no-late-effect barrier after rejected input; return actual counters. A sleep alone is insufficient.
eg.drain: Bounded finality with actual {turns,deliveries,pending,unknown,lateEffects}; never treat timeout as success.
eg.events: Seeded disposable event(s) include the original eventRef, eventId, bindingId, bindingGeneration, consumerId, conversationId, destination, expiry and independent expected activity/artifact digest. Never return credentials. event_context itself submits the tested event.
eg.captureEffects: captureEffects({key?,eventId?,kind?}) returns actual synthetic platform effects with destination/contentDigest. No predicted effects.
eg.dropReplyResponse: Submit one reply with the given frozen key/body then drop only the response after actual acceptance; return outcome:unknown. This is one real POST, never an adapter retry.
eg.reconcileReply: Read retained activity/receipt for the original key through the peer; return {key,delivery,sendAttempts}. Never resend.
eg.continuationReceipts: Read independent AM/provider/platform receipts for the specified event -> [{attachmentIndex,kind,responseId,status,delivery}].
eg.keyMetadata: Read non-secret key identifier and independent rotation count, recordId and owner; never key values.
eg.scanBrowserForCredentialValues: Compare page text and input values against fixture-owned credentials internally; return only {matches,scannedText,scannedInputs}, never the values.
eg.armFault: Scoped local fault injection. drop_test_response loses one Node test response after its admission; cleanup must disarm it.
eg.reconcileTest: Read the original test activity/response -> {turnCount,resubmissions}; no extra test request.
eg.inventory_setup: channel_inventory requires >=2 real pages, >=1 record with missing address, exact expected.channels/nodeNames and a foreign owner marker. github_inventory requires >=2 pages plus exact owned/foreign App refs and expected capability flags.
eg.channel_setup: channelName, channelId, updateBody (credential-free baseline), expected producer/consumer node accessible names, firstText, and unrelatedChannelId/unrelatedChannelDigest. Cleanup must remove only the acquired disposable channel; accept already-deleted owned resources.
eg.baseline: Independent counters measured after fixture setup: turns, effects, deliveries and executionLeaseRenewals. Counters exposed to cases must be numeric and scoped to the lease.
eg.am_evidence: retainTurn emits schema multi-am-eg-evidence-v1, secrets_redacted:true, requests:amRequests with each actual c275-serving-v1 request receipt (serving, serving_after, started_at, ended_at, attribution, request_id), eg_receipts:[] and event/response hashes. Shared runner must ingest this schema for counts. EG-only requests never get AM ownership invented.

eg_accounts.setup: Synthetic local identities with current authorization on each AM and EG. Never substitute an owner header for an authenticated grant. Credentials remain opaque in adapters.
eg_accounts.revoke: revoke({identity,organization,fixture}) invalidates the synthetic organization grant in the local issuer; lease cleanup restores only its owned grant.

eg_browser.prepare: prepare({session,actor,options,ctx}) -> {close,...metadataAndControls}; this fixture augments the shared browser session, never replaces its Page or performs assertions.
eg_browser.identity: identity:{displayName,initials,subject,canOpenOperations}; user must manage own bots and lack Operations capability; admin must have Operations capability.
eg_browser.options: avatar:unavailable, usage:populated, identityIsolation:true, session:absent|denied|expired|delayed_success. Set up only synthetic identities, media and the owner-authorized local fault controls before initial navigation.
eg_browser.usage: For populated usage, seed owned Sandbox rows and allocated totals. Supply usage:{from,to,fromWithZone,toWithZone}; from/to are datetime-local values, zoned counterparts identify the exact same instants. Interval ordered, <=30 days, ending in the past.
eg_browser.clipboard: clipboard(allow|deny) scoped to this browser context. buildText is the exact compiled artifact build string.
eg_browser.permissions: Read current session/capabilities as {authenticated,subject,canCreateChannels}, independently from UI.
eg_browser.waitForHeldSession: Wait for the local proxy to hold the successful service-session response; do not time this with arbitrary sleeps.
eg_browser.denyPendingAction: Produce a real current-session 403 for a pending action in the same page; do not replace the React DOM.
eg_browser.releaseHeldSession: Release the original delayed successful session response after logout or denial.
eg_browser.networkIdle: Wait for the scoped observation/fault barrier; do not wait indefinitely on an SSE connection.
eg_browser.seedVisibleDrafts: Populate synthetic previous-owner drafts and usage fixtures. Supply previousIdentityMarkers and otherIdentity.displayName; never use real user data.
eg_browser.signIn: signIn({actor:outsider}) changes identity through the local authorized login fixture in the same browser context.
eg_browser.close: Restore faults/authorization and remove exact test-owned data; failure must prevent PASS.

scenario_contracts.github_app_lifecycle: Seed local App ID, independently scoped owner, unrelated App digest and verification evidence. keys.create is fixed. retainApp captures owned public cleanup; creation key is retained before POST for uncertain recovery. probeWebhookCredentials signs real local webhook bytes with old/new slots and returns acceptance counts; never return credentials.
scenario_contracts.github_installation: Seed allowed and denied installations/repositories in the local GitHub simulator. retainBinding captures exact cleanup; installationBindings reads actual persisted installation IDs. No real GitHub configuration changes.
scenario_contracts.github_webhook: githubWebhook signs retained synthetic payload bytes and submits real ingress, returning deliveryId/receiptId and status; invalid signature never creates work. waitForTask observes exact real provider completion, turnCount and response identity. drain measures actual pending/unknown/turns.
scenario_contracts.mcp_tools: Seed one attested event with Agent and wrong-consumer actors, independently expected disabledTools, stable distinct keys.a/keys.b. request preserves JSON-RPC framing/protocol headers and actual EG process identity; captureEffects records real platform replies. No simulated MCP responses.
scenario_contracts.message_effects: Seed real retained message refs, stale/unsupported refs and a second uncertainty message. dropMessageEffectResponse submits once with the frozen body/key and loses the accepted response only; reconcileMessageEffect reads receipt with sendAttempts. captureEffects returns actual messageId/destination per key.
scenario_contracts.inbound_attachments: platformSend sends four synthetic wire kinds image/document/audio/video with independent sizes/digests. awaitMediaReady reads actual readiness. consumeDownload uses the one-use opaque capability internally, returns only status/digest/size; credentials and URLs with capabilities cannot enter evidence.
scenario_contracts.conversation_history: Seed paginated platform-returned history and exact IDs. revokeHistoryConsent updates only the acquired source with expected version. history/provider counters and negative actors establish no scope expansion.
scenario_contracts.native_telegram: Local native bot + callback secret fixture. platformConfiguration reads actual registration; platformSend sends private/group updates and invalid secrets. Delivery capture includes original platform reply-to ID.
scenario_contracts.native_discord: Local Discord Gateway simulator with active record, message-content intent, private/server contexts and retained reaction. Configuration reads actual activation capacity. Negative variants include inactive source, bot message and unknown reaction.
scenario_contracts.native_whatsapp: Local signed phone/account ingress, verification challenge and private event. webhookChallenge compares exact digest; captureEffects includes acknowledgement destination. No real WhatsApp traffic.
scenario_contracts.native_lark_resources: Local native Lark app and scoped resource connection. resourceOperation performs the offered document/resource/message operation with selected or foreign connection; resourceEffects is actual capture. Controls/forms are explicitly disabled in this fixture.
scenario_contracts.consumer_actions: consumer_test/disable/enable/rotate-keys/delete require disposable Bot and linked Agent/channel with independent owner/credential version. armFault loses exactly one accepted action response; browserReadBarrier waits on actual read completion. testTurnReceipt returns provider/AM proof. credentialUseReceipts uses only version metadata; linkedResources verifies actual revocation/removal and retained conversations. Cleanup reconciles accepted work before exact deletion.
scenario_contracts.binding_partitions: Seed known binding/generation with two independent conversation partitions. submitFrozenBindingEvent sends original authority after unbind and crossOwnerConversation reads under a different owner; both expose real denial/no-turn observations.
scenario_contracts.channel_attribution: Seed gateway record/version and manager/shared-reader actors. Actual AM GET receipts bind ingress. Channel usage history contains attach/use/detach revisions from this isolated Agent.
scenario_contracts.provider_preparation: providerCard fetches actual allowlisted discovery. inspectPreparation/prepareBinding send service-authenticated public requests using opaque runtime credential injection; return exact receipt/status and retain real AM request proof. Counters measure allocations/preparations independently.
scenario_contracts.am_media_supplement: Seed original frozen event/attachment bytes plus digest, generation and target. uploadFrozenAttachment sends exact bytes once with frozen query/body and optionally drops its response. It retains actual request/AM owner proof; continuationReceipts reads real AM/provider effects. No reupload on uncertainty.
scenario_contracts.thread_lifecycle: Real native Discord parent/event, create/join/leave/rename/archive/reopen enabled; independent parentId and stable action keys. Three unsupportedEvents have exact kinds private_thread/forum_post/general_topic with current consent off. retainThread tracks scoped cleanup; threadEffects reads actual synthetic platform effects, never predicts success.
scenario_contracts.native_interactions: Real current native form event plus offered button/selection controls. Stable prepare/send keys and exact formMessage; request injects Form-Preparation-Ref only internally. interactionCallback submits real wire callbacks for valid/replay/expired/wrong-consumer/revoked variants. waitForTurn returns actual AM proof; withdrawSourceConsent edits acquired source with expected version.
scenario_contracts.whatsapp_group_consent: Local verified phone with explicit allowed group IDs, retained message, form event and separate pendingEvent. Two prepared forms: one explicit send, one revoked before commit. Capture per-event effects; withdraw only the scoped fixture source consent and restore/cleanup publicly.
scenario_contracts.usage_details_browser: eg_browser.prepare options usageFilters/usageDetails/measuredUsage/usageLifecycle seed real owned report data. usage includes sandboxName/Id, agentName, detailSandboxName/Id, historyTransactionIds; >=51 rows, measured metrics with at least one unavailable measurement, and real allocation events. No mocked DOM or successful report bodies.
scenario_contracts.usage_fault_browser: usageFault:report_view_disabled/missing_route/pending/expired/forbidden/transient/other_501 installs scoped local endpoint faults. awaitUsageFault observes trigger; usagePollLedger reads exact created/polled report IDs and pending state; usageObservationBarrier uses bounded scheduler/network observation to prove closed/hidden requests stopped. networkIdle ignores persistent streams. Restore every fault on close.
scenario_contracts.channel_capabilities: Acquire a real disposable channel inventory and compiled gateway page. egRequest GET /v1/channel-capabilities must return actual capability records; browser selectors act on the real form. Cleanup restores only acquired draft.
scenario_contracts.channel_create: Reserve a stable record_id and credential-bearing create body inside the adapter; createChannel sends one real POST and registers readback/delete custody before the request. Adapter returns public definition only.
scenario_contracts.channel_create_uncertain: arm fault to drop only the create response after acceptance; createChannelDropResponse reports unknown with original record/key. Record lookup and counters prove one persisted channel and no changed retry.
scenario_contracts.channel_admission: Seed allowlist/scoped sender and grouping policy, real custom/platform ingress events and independent conversation IDs. counters and partition reads are actual observations.
scenario_contracts.consumer_profile: Seed allowlisted provider card and credential-free profile. update/read real channel through both replicas; adapter scan proves secrets remain opaque.
scenario_contracts.multi_consumer_routing: Seed disposable routing with default targets, matching/unmatched/over-limit events and expected_version. counters report actual target/effect counts.
scenario_contracts.channel_activity: Seed retained events and an actual activity stream endpoint with cursor reset/expiry. activitySnapshot/activityStream/activityDetail read real responses and cleanup leaves no event data.
scenario_contracts.outbound_prepare: Seed saved destination and exact platform message/media fixtures. POST outbound-messages creates prepared receipt; captureEffects confirms no delivery.
scenario_contracts.outbound_send: Seed three disposable prepared deliveries: send, uncertain and cancel. dropOutboundSendResponse submits one accepted send then drops response; outboundStatus reconciles without resend; drain counts real attempts.
scenario_contracts.managed_connection_inventory: Seed >=2 owner connection pages including one ready/unbound, one bound/not-ready and foreign. Real list/get/create channel uses exact connection_ref; cleanup deletes acquired channel.
scenario_contracts.connection_browser_setup: Seed attested originating event and one-use setup capability. eg_browser supplies real browser_session origin and submitConnectionBrowserForm performs one CSRF/Origin-checked POST; no secret is returned.
scenario_contracts.connection_cancel: Seed uncommitted disposable setup; DELETE only acquired connection and verify one-use setup link 404 after cancellation.
scenario_contracts.consumer_inventory: Seed >=2 owner Consumers plus foreign, exact linked channel/Agent and current state. API list/detail/connections read actual records.
scenario_contracts.consumer_create: Seed disposable owner connection, worker profile and Bot create payload. Real POST with stable key and peer polling observes actual provisioning/channel; cleanup removes Bot and linked resources.
scenario_contracts.bot_father_profile: Seed attested Bot Father draft, owner identity, profile digest and disposable create payload. publishBotFatherProfile uses durable revision/key; cleanup exact.
scenario_contracts.bot_father_actions: Seed real attested event and Bot setup store. botSetupAdvance/action are direct EG-backed calls, not a result oracle; action receipts retain setup/revision and cleanup releases only acquired setup.
scenario_contracts.console_session: eg_console.open binds a real EG console browser_session to each leased EG origin; completeLocalLogin uses the local NyxID fixture, switchEG changes EG origin while preserving cookie, evidence captures actual request IDs. No bearer substitution.
scenario_contracts.console_inspection: Seed owner channel with endpoint/settings/activity and one missing-address record. eg_console evidence, link form and scanBrowserForCredentialValues use real HTML; cleanup unlinks only acquired address.
scenario_contracts.console_source_lifecycle: Seed disposable channel with source, routing reference and second source. Forms use CSRF and expected_version; submitGuardedFormVariant drives actual refusal; cleanup restores source set.
scenario_contracts.producer_edit: Seed a disposable channel with two distinct producer sources and routing references; expected.updatedRouteIds and expected.removeSourceId identify the selected change/removal. updateBody contains the public baseline; request uses actual EG revisions and cleanup removes only this owned channel. This is distinct from the single custom-source channel_edit setup for EG-022.

implemented_setup_exports.module: setup.mjs exports createEgTransport, channelEditSetup, parentEgSetup and setups; index.mjs re-exports setups for the shared registry. Every remaining scenario setup calls the authentic parent EG acquire factory, registers cleanup custody before the case action, and validates its concrete fixture surface; no setup returns a case result oracle.
implemented_setup_exports.channel_edit: Implemented real HTTP setup for EG-022 through user-fixtures.take(channel_edit, ctx). Generates disposable HMAC/channel keys at runtime, reserves a UUID, creates a custom-source channel with the leased owner/profile/provider, then recovers and deletes only the reserved record with current expected_version. No fixture result oracle.
implemented_setup_exports.parent_primitives: primitives.eg supplies scope:LOCAL_DISPOSABLE_TWO_AM, synthetic:true, shared_database:true, expectedImage, expectedSource, topology(), authorize(), witness(), leaseAuthority(). Missing prerequisites BLOCKED before resource creation.
implemented_setup_exports.topology: Returns a/b each {origin,instance,ready,image,source}; origins must be separate direct loopback forwards and images/source exactly match qualified parent binding.
implemented_setup_exports.authorize: authorize({actor,method,path,replica}) returns runtime authentication headers for the scoped synthetic identity. Credentials remain only in memory and are never observed or logged.
implemented_setup_exports.witness: witness({replica,method,path,status,responseRequestId}) returns {slot,instance,requestId} from independent actual ingress capture; it must match response request ID if provided. Requested slot alone is insufficient.
implemented_setup_exports.leaseAuthority: leaseAuthority({caseId,phase,iteration}) -> {local:true,synthetic:true,agentKey,profile,provider,close}. Supplies only pre-authorized synthetic owner/profile/provider inputs, does not create channels or perform tested features. The browser user must be the same owner. close restores the bounded authority lease.
implemented_setup_exports.boundary: No runtime evidence exists yet. Tests use local HTTP test servers to verify transport/cleanup mechanics only. The named setups are source implementations that bind the parent acquire contract; the parent still must install authentic EG, browser and account providers before runtime execution.
implemented_setup_exports.parent_scenarios: channel_capabilities, channel_create, channel_create_uncertain, producer_edit, channel_admission, consumer_profile, multi_consumer_routing, channel_activity, outbound_prepare, outbound_send, managed_connection_inventory, connection_browser_setup, connection_cancel, consumer_inventory, consumer_create, bot_father_profile, bot_father_actions, console_session, console_inspection, console_source_lifecycle
implemented_setup_exports.am_receipts: AM-backed setup evidence retains each actual request_id, serving, serving_after, started_at, ended_at and attribution field from c275-serving-v1; EG-only receipts remain separate and never receive invented AM ownership.
implemented_setup_exports.dispatch: The 20 remaining cases declare user-fixtures and call the registry-bound named setup. Each parent acquire lease must expose cleanup() or close(); both returned aliases share one release promise, preserving rejection without retry.

eg_console.open: open({actor,replica,lease,authenticated}) returns the real local EG console session {page,origin,authentication:browser_session,switchEG,close}. Bound to the existing parent browser; never launch another browser or send console paths to an AM.
eg_console.evidence: evidence(page) returns multi-eg-browser-evidence-v1 with real_ui:true, secrets_redacted:true, authentication:browser_session and independently observed EG requests {replica,instance,request_id}; no invented AM receipt.
eg_console.controls: completeLocalLogin({session,page}), expireSession({session,page}), sessionMetadata({session,page}), ownerAttempt({session,page,owner}), linkedAddress({session,page,recordId}), submitGuardedFormVariant({session,page,path,variant}) are low-level operations on the actual session and forms, not case-result delegates. Missing operations remain BLOCKED.
eg_console.cleanup: Close only acquired contexts; preserve failure evidence and reconcile all owned public resources before parent infrastructure release.
